notes.title: New Indie Horror Publisher + News
notes.notes: [p]While we've been working quietly away on Nightmare House, we wanted to bring you some news! Development is going well, supported by the fact that we've just partnered with new indie horror publisher [url="https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/blacklanterncollective"]Black Lantern Collective[/url]. Their experience in indie horror over the years makes this a really good match to get the very best out of the new Nightmare House game.[/p][p][/p][p]But wait, where did the "[i]Reimagined[/i]" go? We decided to drop it from the title because we felt it may give the wrong impression of what the game will be. We're working our ass off to deliver a classic [i]Nightmare House [/i]experience, with our scare system, humor, story and combat that you're familiar with. The new Nightmare House game will be all that- [i]and more[/i]. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160346/4e66e523998203689f6c3b7b7db892f00e857ba1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]If you were at BitSummit in Japan this past week, you might have seen us at the Black Lantern Collective booth with a playable demo. It was fun to let players get their hands on the game for the first time and we learned a lot watching them play![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160346/81ed889e87f0150024ce85092be2833aa31a584e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We have more in the works that we're excited to show you soon™, including some new gameplay! Stay tuned. [/p][p][/p][p]Ido / We Create Stuff[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Nightmare House: The Original Mod is OUT and FREE!
notes.notes:
While you wait for Nightmare House: Reimagined to release, we thought it would make sense to go back and explore the roots of our classic Half-Life 2 mod.

So we've decided to put it on Steam for free. And it's available right now:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954780/Nightmare_House_The_Original_Mod

So if you're itching to revisit this classic, or dive in to the Nightmare House franchise for the first time - we'd love your support to spread the word around.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160346/355d2ac949cc61680aa9dc065ccdec37853e6ac5.gif[/img]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5zQENkZEttc
